input: Label and store all camping gear in the shed

gold.taskTitle: Label and Store All Camping Gear in Shed
gold.taskDescription: Organise, label, and store all camping gear in the shed in a structured and accessible way.

questions.title: How much camping gear needs to be sorted?
questions.description: Understand the volume of gear involved — a few bags, or a full collection spanning tents, cooking gear, clothing, tools, and more.

questions.title: Where is the gear currently located right now?
questions.description: Find out the starting point — is the gear scattered across the house, in a garage, piled in the shed already, or somewhere else?

questions.title: What storage infrastructure already exists in the shed?
questions.description: Determine whether there are shelves, hooks, bins, or racks already in place, or if storage furniture needs to be added first.

questions.title: What labelling method do you want to use?
questions.description: Clarify the preferred labelling approach — handwritten tags, printed labels, colour-coded bins, or a labelling gun.

questions.title: Should gear be grouped by category, person, or trip type?
questions.description: Establish the organisational logic — for example, grouped by item type (shelter, cooking, clothing), by family member, or by trip purpose (day hike vs. multi-night).

questions.title: Is any gear damaged, expired, or due to be replaced?
questions.description: Find out whether decluttering or disposal is part of this task, or if everything being stored is in active use and kept.

questions.title: When does this need to be fully completed by?
questions.description: Identify any deadline or urgency — such as an upcoming camping trip, a seasonal cleanout, or a general timeline preference.
